items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 15:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that Aba and Ima are from the aspect of the direct light, only that the aspects 1 and 2 in them, and the aspects 3 and 4 in them, are only in the way of inclusion from the lower ones. However, ZA is the third aspect of the direct light, and therefore there is no foreskin in Aba and Ima, for the aspect of the foreskin is the fourth aspect of coarseness, which has no coupling at all in the world of Atzilut, and wherever it appears, immediately the Upper Light departs from there; and since ZA is the third aspect of the direct light, behold, this fourth aspect begins with the end of his Partzuf, namely, after the crown of his Yesod, and therefore the souls cannot rise as MAN before they remove the aspect of the foreskin from there, for as long as this foreskin is found there, the Upper Light is removed from there, and they need to correct the three years of the foreskin from the three lines of the NHY of ZA, namely, from the aspect of the end of the three lines, where the standing of the foreskin is, as above. And afterwards, the fourth year is in the secret of "holy praises," and afterwards they can rise as MAN. But in Aba and Ima no foreskin is discerned at their end, because they are completely far from the fourth aspect, for they end in the second aspect of the direct light, as above. (Item 7).
